description: This file contains unit tests for tenantClient utility functions used in the frontend of a data management dashboard. It tests functions like normalizeTenantId, fetchSessionTenants, selectTenant, and setActiveTenant, verifying their behavior and interactions with browser APIs such as fetch and localStorage.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes various tenant identifier formats into a string or null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches tenant items associated with the current session from the server.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Sets the active tenant both in local storage and via a server call.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Stores the preferred active tenant ID in local storage, replacing legacy keys.
